_______
In summary, recovery isn’t just what happens after your workout. The best
coaches and sport scientists in the world have a much broader view of what
recovery means—it’s how you plan your day, your week, and your training
block to allow for optimal recovery from the last session, as well as to
prepare for the upcoming session. In the next chapter, I’ll discuss the
fundamental role of athlete immunity and how it relates to recovery.
